Usage: perch shell init <bash|fish|zsh>
                                  Print the shell integration script
       perch shell install    Add the shell integration to your rc file

install reads your shell from $SHELL and appends one line to ~/.bashrc,
~/.config/fish/conf.d/perch.fish (under $XDG_CONFIG_HOME if set), or
~/.zshrc (under $ZDOTDIR if set). Running it again changes nothing.
